description: list habits with today toggle and a compact 7-day grid per habit
spec:
1. Build a habit list page rendering all non-archived habits.
2. Show each habit name, notes/target, and current streak.
3. Render a compact 7-day grid per habit reflecting real check-ins.
4. Provide a today done/undo toggle on each row.
5. Toggling updates the grid and streak without a full reload.
6. Show a loading state while habits fetch.
7. Show an empty state when no habits exist yet.
8. Confirm archived habits do not appear.
9. Verify the page is reachable from navigation.
10. Run `bun run smoke:qc` and confirm it passes.
title: Habit list page
